notes.title: Okinawa Rush has been released! -15% launch discount
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/95ee26c09dc10852dd14704bc80c831173ba7e78.png

Hiya, fighters!

And the biggest hiya yet! After all this time it finally happened - Okinawa Rush is out! A big Thank you to everyone for supporting the game on this journey, for pledging to the Kickstarter, for wishlisting on various storefronts, for playing the demo, telling your friends about it, sending us feedback or just the kind words! We really couldn’t have done it without you. 

LAUNCH TRAILER
[previewyoutube=hfJtq6LGFMI;full][/previewyoutube]
Launch Discount

You may remember a little thing called the Highscore Quest from last week, where we collected wishlists and certain thresholds unlocked higher launch discounts. Well, thanks to your concerted efforts, we have managed to reach our First Goal (that ensure a -10% release discount) and collect over 250 wishlists in one week, but… because we really love you and we’d like to thank you for your continuing support, we set a release discount at -15% anyway!

Now, without further ado, we are proud to present Okinawa Rush! Hope you’ll have as much fun playing it as we’ve had when making it!

Anyway, have fun, and stay fighting!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/777670/Okinawa_Rush/

Hello, treasure hunters!

A week ago we published Tanuki Justice, but we’d like to deliver even more fun to all retro fans! Check out Golden Force that just came out here on Steam! The action-platformer where you perform complex combos, slides, and dash attacks. Unlock new areas, collect throwable items, fight underwater, avoid spiky obstacles, and master each stage.
